description: This file defines a Retrofit API interface for managing order-related network operations in the frontend of an online shopping platform. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, listing, and transitioning order statuses such as paid, shipped, delivered, and canceled.

classes.name: OrderApi
classes.description: A Retrofit interface providing endpoints for order lifecycle management, including creation, retrieval, listing, and status transitions.

methods.name: createOrder
methods.description: Creates a new order with the specified order creation request data.

methods.name: getOrderById
methods.description: Retrieves details of an order by its unique identifier.

methods.name: listOrders
methods.description: Fetches a paginated list of orders with optional filtering parameters such as status, email, and date range.

methods.name: markPaid
methods.description: Updates an order's status to paid.

methods.name: markShipped
methods.description: Updates an order's status to shipped.

methods.name: markDelivered
methods.description: Updates an order's status to delivered.
